title: Return Values
summary: The return statement hands a result back to whoever called the function, then ends the function immediately.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: The return statement hands a result back to whoever called the function, then ends the function immediately.
Without return, a function produces no usable result — it can still print or modify things, but callers get nothing back.
Key points: code after return is unreachable, you can return any value including collections, and some languages return multiple values.
Summary: Return Values — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.

keyTakeaways: Key points: code after return is unreachable, you can return any value including collections, and some languages return multiple values.
